orthographyReview: Fouquet is transcribed as فوكي / فوكيي; captions retain the approved فوكيه.
Greene is transcribed as جرين; captions retain غرين.
Vaux-le-Vicomte word segmentation differs between recognizers; captions retain فو لو فيكونت.
Numbers normalized by ASR are represented with Western digits in captions.
scope: Two independent local ASR model sizes, source prompt hash and recording-derived alignment. ASR is imperfect and does not constitute a human listening review or a guarantee of every phoneme.
